lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: proving the Pythagorean theorem using similarity
lessonRef.title: Transfer challenge: proving the Pythagorean theorem using similarity

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: The example is from a different context than the problems below.

items.prompt: A 2 m pole casts a 3 m shadow; a tree casts a 12 m shadow. Tree height?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A line parallel to one side of a triangle divides the other two sides proportionally. Which statement correctly justifies it?
choices: The parallel line creates corresponding angles, giving a smaller triangle similar to the original by AA, so the sides are in proportion.
The parallel line bisects both sides by definition.
The two parts of each side are congruent because the line is parallel.
The result follows from the Pythagorean theorem applied twice.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF. Side AB = 3 corresponds to DE = 6. If BC = 9, find EF.
In a right triangle, the altitude to the hypotenuse divides it into segments of length 8 and 128. Find the altitude.
A 7 m pole casts a 2 m shadow. At the same moment a building casts a 18 m shadow. How tall is the building?
Two triangles with all three pairs of sides in the same ratio are similar. Which statement correctly justifies it?
choices: This is the SSS congruence criterion applied directly.
The criterion holds only when the ratio is a whole number.
Equal ratios of sides guarantee congruence, not similarity.
This is the SSS similarity criterion: a dilation matches one triangle’s sides to the other’s, and the resulting figures are congruent.

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: These are meant to be hard. Show the reasoning even if you do not finish.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF. Side AB = 4 corresponds to DE = 20. If BC = 7, find EF.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: In a right triangle, the altitude to the hypotenuse divides it into segments of length 11 and 99. Find the altitude.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A 7 m pole casts a 7 m shadow. At the same moment a building casts a 35 m shadow. How tall is the building?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
